entry.name: Machine Learning Crash Course
entry.note: Google's refreshed MLCC with interactive visuals and Keras exercises

reading.format: Animated videos, interactive visualizations, and hands-on practice exercises. Modules are self-contained.
reading.summary: This is a practical introduction to machine learning from Google. It uses animated videos, interactive visualizations, and hands-on exercises. The course covers fundamentals, data preparation, advanced model architectures, and real world deployment considerations. Completing it shows familiarity with core machine learning concepts and practices.
reading.audience: It is for people who want to learn how machine learning works. It suits both beginners and those with prior machine learning experience.
